import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define constants and parameters
n = 100
a = 0.0
b = 15.0
sigma = 0.1
max_spline_order = 4
nbreak = 10

# Define ctypes prototypes for the GSL functions
class gsl_vector(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("stride", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("block", ctypes.c_void_p),
        ("owner", ctypes.c_int)
    ]

class gsl_bspline_workspace(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

# Function prototypes
bspline_alloc = gsl.gsl_bspline_alloc
bspline_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
bspline_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_bspline_workspace)

bspline_knots_uniform = gsl.gsl_bspline_knots_uniform
bspline_knots_uniform.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(gsl_bspline_workspace)]
bspline_knots_uniform.restype = ctypes.c_int

bspline_eval = gsl.gsl_bspline_eval
bspline_eval.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(gsl_vector), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_bspline_workspace)]
bspline_eval.restype = ctypes.c_int

vector_alloc = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc
vector_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
vector_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_vector)

vector_free = gsl.gsl_vector_free
vector_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_vector)]
vector_free.restype = None


def call_gsl_bspline_fit():
    # Prepare input and output arrays
    x_values = np.linspace(a, b, n).astype(np.float64)
    y_values = np.cos(x_values) * np.exp(-0.1 * x_values) + np.random.normal(0, sigma, n)
    weights = np.full(n, 1.0 / (sigma * sigma), dtype=np.float64)
    fitted_values = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.float64)

    # Allocate workspace and vectors
    bw = bspline_alloc(max_spline_order, nbreak)
    B = vector_alloc(nbreak + max_spline_order - 2)

    # Create uniform knots
    if bspline_knots_uniform(a, b, bw) != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("Error creating B-spline knots")

    # Evaluate B-spline basis functions at each x value
    for i, x in enumerate(x_values):
        if bspline_eval(x, B, bw) != 0:
            raise RuntimeError("Error evaluating B-spline basis functions")
        # Sum the basis function values for demonstration purposes
        fitted_values[i] = sum(B.contents.data[j] for j in range(nbreak + max_spline_order - 2))

    # Free allocated memory
    vector_free(B)

    return fitted_values


def assert_test():
    fitted_values = call_gsl_bspline_fit()

    # Validate the output shape
    assert fitted_values.shape == (n,), "Output shape mismatch"

    # Validate that the fitted values are finite
    assert np.all(np.isfinite(fitted_values)), "Fitted values contain non-finite numbers"

    # Validate that the fitted values are within a reasonable range
    assert np.all(fitted_values >= -10.0) and np.all(fitted_values <= 10.0), "Fitted values out of range"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
    print("All tests passed.")
